description: This file implements a WebSocket-based Speech-to-Text (STT) service named CartesiaSTTService, which interfaces with Cartesia's Live transcription API for real-time speech recognition. It includes configuration options, connection management, message handling, and integration with a larger speech processing pipeline.

classes.name: CartesiaLiveOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Cartesia Live STT service, including model, language, encoding, and sample rate settings.

classes.name: CartesiaSTTService
classes.description: A speech-to-text service class that manages WebSocket connection, message handling, and transcription processing using Cartesia's API.
